## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Only optional test corrections were found in the reviewed scope, which includes a complete version-0 report that exercises the new rejection path.

## Changes

The parser now requires the first line to equal `REPORT v1`. The pull request adds two tests intended to verify rejection of unsupported versions.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

(none)

## Suggestions

- tests/test_report.py:11 — tests — Remove the test that bypasses header validation — The generated fixture has `REPORT v1` as its header and lacks `END`, so `test_rejects_legacy_header` passes even if the version check is removed. `rsplit("v1", 1)` changes the body value. — This test stays green when header validation regresses.
- app/report.py:5 — tests — Test a header that extends `REPORT v1` — A complete report headed `REPORT v10` must return `None`, but every current assertion would also pass if the parser accepted any header starting with `REPORT v1`. — A prefix-match regression could accept version-10 reports without failing the suite. — Fix: Parameterize `test_rejects_unsupported_header_with_complete_report` to include `REPORT v10`.
